events.title: The Magyars defeat King Louis the Child's army near Augsburg
events.description: A Magyar army defeated the combined forces of East Francia and Swabia, under the nominal command of King Louis the Child, on the Lechfeld south of Augsburg, using the feigned retreat. The victors broke into Franconia for the first time.
events.html: A Magyar army defeated the combined forces of East Francia and Swabia, under the nominal command of King Louis the Child, on the Lechfeld south of Augsburg, using the feigned retreat. The victors broke into Franconia for the first time.

events.title: The Disputation of Paris opens at the court of Louis IX
events.description: At the court of King Louis IX, four rabbis defended the Talmud against the charges of blasphemy pressed by Nicholas Donin, a Jewish convert to Christianity. The disputation led to a decree for the public burning of all available Talmud manuscripts.

events.title: A Paris mob kills Bernard VII of Armagnac and his supporters
events.description: When the Burgundians took Paris during the civil war, a mob killed Bernard VII, Count of Armagnac and constable of France, together with his sympathisers, all prisoners, foreign bankers, and students and faculty of the College of Navarre.
events.html: When the Burgundians took Paris during the civil war, a mob killed Bernard VII, Count of Armagnac and constable of France, together with his sympathisers, all prisoners, foreign bankers, and students and faculty of the College of Navarre.

events.title: Joan of Arc leads the French to capture Jargeau
events.description: On the second day of the Battle of Jargeau, Joan of Arc led the French army in taking the city and capturing the English commander, William de la Pole, 1st Duke of Suffolk. It was her first offensive battle.
events.html: On the second day of the Battle of Jargeau, Joan of Arc led the French army in taking the city and capturing the English commander, William de la Pole, 1st Duke of Suffolk. It was her first offensive battle.

events.title: New York is incorporated as an English city
events.description: Governor Richard Nicolls replaced New Amsterdam's Dutch government with an English mayor, aldermen and sheriff. The English had taken the colony from the Dutch the previous year.
events.html: Governor Richard Nicolls replaced New Amsterdam's Dutch government with an English mayor, aldermen and sheriff. The English had taken the colony from the Dutch the previous year.

events.title: Virginia adopts its Declaration of Rights
events.description: Drafted mainly by George Mason, the Declaration set out rights such as freedom of the press and trial by jury. It influenced the US Bill of Rights and the French Declaration of 1789.
events.html: Drafted mainly by George Mason, the Declaration set out rights such as freedom of the press and trial by jury. It influenced the US Bill of Rights and the French Declaration of 1789.

events.title: Emilio Aguinaldo declares Philippine independence
events.description: At Kawit, Cavite, revolutionaries proclaimed independence from Spain. The United States annexed the islands instead, and full independence came only in 1946.
events.html: At Kawit, Cavite, revolutionaries proclaimed independence from Spain. The United States annexed the islands instead, and full independence came only in 1946.

events.title: Nelson Mandela is sentenced to life imprisonment
events.description: Mandela and seven co-accused in the Rivonia Trial were sentenced to life for sabotage. He spent 27 years in prison before his release in 1990.
events.html: Mandela and seven co-accused in the Rivonia Trial were sentenced to life for sabotage. He spent 27 years in prison before his release in 1990.

events.title: Reagan urges Gorbachev to 'tear down this wall'
events.description: Speaking at the Brandenburg Gate, President Reagan challenged the Soviet leader to open the Berlin Wall. It fell two and a half years later.
events.html: Speaking at the Brandenburg Gate, President Reagan challenged the Soviet leader to open the Berlin Wall. It fell two and a half years later.
